data_access: no Wilson measurement, development/sealed split, GPU or QUDA data read

dgp.source: the same Gaussian-copula Beta moving-sum DGP as the prior finite-dependence report; this study adds a bound and sample-size comparison

colored_empirical_Bernstein.source: Maurer and Pontil (2009), Theorem 11, independent not necessarily identically distributed variables; arXiv:0907.3740
colored_empirical_Bernstein.coloring: index modulo (m+1), valid for this synthetic moving-sum DGP only
colored_empirical_Bernstein.alpha_allocation: LANE_ALPHA / (2 tails * 4 means * chi color classes)
colored_empirical_Bernstein.log_propagation: monotone interval arithmetic through the four log means; zero-crossing intervals abstain

graph_color_Hoeffding.source: same conditional finite-dependence bound as the prior report
graph_color_Hoeffding.purpose: same-sample baseline for adaptive variance interval

limitations: simulation coverage is conditional on the exact synthetic dependence graph and support
the true m is supplied by the synthetic generator and is not estimated from HMC data
the study does not validate theorem assumptions or coverage on physical Wilson configurations
a valid finite-sample interval may remain too wide to pass the 0.02 precision gate
